[^2]: *An *algebra* over a set $`\Omega`$ is a set of subsets of
    $`\Omega`$ that includes both $`\Omega`$ and the empty set and is
    closed under complements, finite unions, and finite intersections;
    this matters for Kolmogorov’s axioms
    (Section <a href="how-is-calibration-possible/extrapolating-calibration.md#extrapolating-calibration" data-reference-type="ref"
    data-reference="ss:axioms">4.2</a>).*
